overloads.semanticRole: Loads the record previously related to the current record, establishing the relation using the pre-modification (old) value of aField instead of its current value.

constraints: Operates the same as RELATE ONE, except the relation is established using the old value of aField (the many field, as returned by the Old function/command), not its current value.
To modify and save the loaded old related record, you must call SAVE RELATED ONE.
There is no old related record for a newly created record.
